title.en: First conditional: if + present, will + verb

explain.ko: 앞으로 실제로 일어날 수 있는 일은 If + 현재형, will + 동사 원형으로 말합니다. if절은 미래의 일이어도 현재형을 씁니다(If it rains ✕ If it will rain). if절이 앞에 오면 쉼표를 찍습니다. unless는 if ~ not과 같고, when / as soon as / before / after도 뒤에 현재형을 씁니다.
explain.en: Talk about real future possibilities with If + present simple, will + base verb. Use the present in the if-clause even though it is about the future (If it rains, not If it will rain). Put a comma when the if-clause comes first. Unless means if … not, and when, as soon as, before and after are also followed by the present simple.

예문 / Example

notes.ko: if절에는 will을 쓰지 않습니다: If it rains (✕ If it will rain).
notes.en: No 'will' in the if-clause: If it rains (not If it will rain).

notes.ko: if절이 문장 앞에 오면 쉼표: If it rains, we'll stay.
notes.en: Use a comma when the if-clause comes first: If it rains, we'll stay.
Might is less certain than will.
